gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve all dynamic webhooks registered for my application so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of dynamic webhooks with their details, including the webhook ID, URL, and events they are subscribed to.

gold.user: As an application owner, I need to register a new dynamic webhook to receive notifications for specific events in Jira.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the webhook configuration and return a success response with the newly created webhook ID.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to delete a specific webhook that is no longer needed to keep the system clean.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the webhook and return a success message.

gold.user: As a support engineer, I want to check the list of failed webhooks to troubleshoot issues with notifications.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of failed webhooks along with error details and timestamps.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to refresh the webhooks to ensure they are up to date with the latest configurations.
gold.ideal: The API should refresh the webhooks and return a success response indicating that the refresh was successful.
